item.description: The US president seems to have warmed to Anthony Albanese, but the PM is still learning to navigate his changing rules.

item.title: ABC News: Dario Amodei, facing an Oppenheimer moment, races ahead
item.description: Anthropic, despite its co-founder's warning in recent months, is leading the pack on AI development while breaking records with last week's float on the US stock exchange.

item.title: ABC News: Is the Australian Dream easier overseas? Three stories from Berlin
item.description: Ever dreamed of escaping Australia's high cost of living and heading overseas in search of opportunity and a more affordable life? Three Australians moved to Berlin and found cheaper homes and bigger opportunities – but some things are harder to leave behind.

item.title: ABC News: Princess Catherine reflects on cancer journey in new documentary
item.description: Princess Catherine will share her experience with cancer and recovery in a new documentary to be broadcast internationally in the coming weeks.

item.title: ABC News: Mexico's military captures drug kingpin on FBI's most wanted list
item.description: Meza Flores was one of the FBI's 10 most wanted fugitives and the alleged leader of the Beltran Leyva gang, which is allied with one of two rival factions in the powerful Sinaloa cartel.

item.title: ABC News: Australia win thriller to snap England's T20I streak
item.description: Inexperienced Australia have pulled off a record MCG run chase to beat world number one England in the first of five T20 Internationals on home soil.

item.title: ABC News: Top End shaken as major quake hits East Timor
item.description: Northern Territory residents were rattled after a 6.8-magnitude earthquake struck north-east of Lospalos in East Timor on Saturday.

item.title: ABC News: World record-breaking Australian swimmer Jon Henricks dies aged 91
item.description: Jon Henricks, the record-breaking Australian swimmer who won two gold medals at the 1956 Melbourne Olympics, has died at the age of 91.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: Lehmann denies knowledge of sandpaper plot despite Bancroft statement
item.description: Former Australian cricket coach Darren Lehmann apologises for his role in the sandpaper saga from 2018, but denies that he knew of the plan prior to it happening.

item.title: ABC News: Eyre Peninsula residents worried about further blackouts
item.description: With work underway to stabilise the Eyre Peninsula's power grid, locals say they want to have more confidence in the region's energy security.

item.description: Australia's veteran bowlers continue to insist they knew nothing of a plot to tamper with the ball, but the damage to their legacies began before the release of Usman Khawaja's book.

item.description: Police do not believe the two men were known to each other.
